title: Project Toner - Capital A x PremCom UK

summary.overview:
- Capital A operates as an international M&A advisory firm, focusing on buy/sell side transactions with a presence in major cities like London, New York, Texas, and California.
- Project Toner involves a print business spin-out from a larger marketing company sold to an American client, as current owners aim to concentrate on marketing agencies.
- The target business has an annual revenue near £2 million and an EBITDA of £120-130k, reflecting a 5% profit margin and strong ties to sports brands such as Premier League clubs and major companies like Apple and Nike.
- PremCom was acquired by Martin Horsman on May 1st through pre-packed administration after extensive due diligence, addressing supplier relationships and organizational challenges.
- Smart Group (SRMT) is positioned as the holding company for PremCom, with a defined strategy focused on consolidating acquisitions within the print sector.
- Simon Morris, with 7-8 years of M&A experience, is leading the investment strategy, currently exploring two local print acquisitions that complement PremCom's client base.
- The acquisition strategy emphasizes geographic proximity and complementary capabilities, with plans to enhance senior management with experienced hires in print.
- Initial steps include an executed NDA, with an Information Memorandum (IM) pending seller approval for financial disclosure.
- CFO availability is limited until the following week, with a target to hold the first client meeting after the absence.
- A weekly NDA approval process ensures that client information is shared with only authorized buyers.
summary.short_summary: Capital A operates as an international M&A advisory firm, specializing in buy/sell side transactions across major cities like London, New York, Texas, and California. The meeting centered on Project Toner, involving a spin-out of a print business from a larger marketing company, which is being sold to an American client as the current owners shift their focus to marketing agencies. The target business boasts an annual revenue of nearly £2 million with an EBITDA of £120-130k, showcasing a 5% profit margin and strong affiliations with sports brands such as Premier League clubs and major corporations like Apple and Nike. Martin Horsman acquired PremCom on May 1st, after addressing supplier relationships and organizational challenges. The holding company, Smart Group (SRMT), is consolidating acquisitions in the print sector under Simon Morris, who is leading the investment strategy and exploring local print acquisitions to enhance their client base. Initial steps include an executed NDA and a pending Information Memorandum (IM) for financial disclosure, with client meetings targeted for the following week.
